hypothesis: After the failover, the Connect offsets of pg-orders-connector were not copied to the new worker, so task 0 asks for slot debezium_orders at a stale LSN; restart the connector.

verdict.reason: The hypothesis blames Connect offsets that were not copied to the new worker, which places the cause in kafka-connect. It does not say the logical slot is missing on the new Postgres primary, and it recommends a plain restart.
